Allah created Adam sixty cubits tall and sent him to greet the angels, whose reply became his offspring's greeting; Paradise's people will have his form, and people have shrunk since.
Allah created Adam in His picture, sixty cubits tall, and had him greet the angels, whose reply became his offspring's greeting; all entering Paradise will have Adam's form.
When Moses blamed Adam for turning them out of Paradise, Adam answered that Allah had written that deed forty years before creating him, and so Adam won the argument.
Moses blamed Adam for turning his offspring out of Paradise; Adam answered that Moses blamed him for what was ordained before his creation, and so Adam prevailed.
